name: sun
description: Generate podcasts, guided meditations, bedtime stories and original songs with SUN.

interface.longDescription: Ask SUN to turn any topic into a podcast, or into something to listen to: a guided meditation for sleep, calm or focus, a bedtime story told in chapters, or an original song. Give a podcast a subject and a length or attach files, and SUN writes and narrates a multi-episode course, for example "Make me a 20 minute podcast on the Cuban Missile Crisis". Pick one of SUN's voices, SUN's characters, or your own voice cloned in the SUN app, so a story can be read to your child in your voice. Listen as soon as the first part is ready. You can also schedule recurring audio briefings that arrive in the SUN app.
defaultPrompt: Make me a 10 minute sleep meditation
Read my son a bedtime story about a brave little rabbit in my own voice
Write a song about my dog Max

positive.prompt: Make me a 20 minute podcast on the Cuban Missile Crisis
positive.expected_behavior: Calls create_audio_course with only the prompt and duration_minutes 20, right away tells the user generation has started and the estimated credit cost the tool states, without showing the job_id, and does not start a second generation. Once a lecture has audio, shares the listen_url as a clickable link.

positive.prompt: Make me a 10 minute sleep meditation
positive.expected_behavior: Calls create_meditation with duration_minutes 10 and purpose sleep without asking what it is for, and shares the listen_url once it is playable.

positive.description: Bedtime story in the user's cloned voice
positive.prompt: Read my son a bedtime story about a brave little rabbit in my own voice
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the voices first, picks the voice_id of the user's cloned voice (kind cloned) and creates a story with create_story, not a course.

positive.prompt: Write a song about my dog Max
positive.expected_behavior: Calls create_song with Max kept in song_request and no length, then returns the lyrics and the listen_url.

positive.description: Schedule and list a recurring briefing
positive.prompt: Every weekday at 8am, brief me on changes to U.S. work-visa rules. I'm in New York. Then: What briefings do I have?
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a weekdays 08:00 briefing in America/New_York and says it will arrive as a SUN app notification; when asked, lists that briefing with its next run time.

negative.description: Missing topic: asks one clarifying question and creates nothing
Made-up voice: explains it is not available, suggests listed voices, invents no voice_id
negative.prompt: Use Morgan Freeman's voice for a podcast on the ocean.

negative.description: Artist imitation: rewrites it as a style description without the artist's name and keeps Luna
negative.prompt: Make a Taylor Swift style song about my cat Luna

review.commerce_description: SUN does not sell anything in ChatGPT. Generating audio uses credits from the user's existing SUN account; the plugin never shows plans or prices and never links to a checkout. Credits are bought only in SUN's own app or website.

publication.release_notes: SUN 1.1.4. More languages: ask in French, German, Italian, Dutch, Portuguese, Russian, Ukrainian, Arabic and its dialects, as well as English, Spanish, Hindi and Chinese, or simply write in your own language, and SUN creates the audio in it. Turn any topic into a narrated podcast, from a topic and a length or from files you attach. Create a guided meditation for sleep, calm, focus or a body scan. Get a bedtime story or other fiction told in chapters, with your child's name and the details you give. Compose an original song, jingle or lullaby, with its lyrics. Choose one of SUN's voices or characters, or use your own voice cloned in the SUN app. Listen as soon as the first part is ready. Schedule recurring or one-off audio briefings that arrive as SUN app notifications, and list or cancel them from ChatGPT.
